cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
import time
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
# Kill old
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pkill -f 'tsx src' 2>&1 || true")
time.sleep(2)
# Start new
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria/server && nohup npx tsx src/index.ts > /tmp/server.log 2>&1 & echo $!")
time.sleep(12)
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:3000")
print("HTTP:", stdout.read().decode())
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ss -tlnp | grep 3000")
print("Port:", stdout.read().decode())
client.close()
EOF
